learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to technically correctly, completely and manufacturing-friendly depict individual components and assemblies.
Students acquire confident handling of CAD functions and methods to create 3D models of components and assemblies for subsequent product development processes.

Through targeted exercises, students acquire basic knowledge for dimensioning manufactured parts and recognize their influence on various manufacturing processes, such as drilling, bending, turning, and milling.
Students work in small groups on technical and practice-oriented problems, develop suitable solutions, and implement them practically.
Students gain initial experience in teamwork and in the application of study-relevant topics such as design, manufacturing, programming, electronics, among others.
After successful completion, students are able to grasp and understand a task within a given subject area.
After successful completion, students are able to develop suitable solutions for implementing a solution.
After successful completion, students are able to critically evaluate these solutions based on the experience gained.
After successful completion, students are able to present the results in a structured written and oral manner.

syllabus_topics: Correct representation of individual parts in technical drawings
Sensible dimensioning of individual parts in technical drawings
Specification of surface roughness, hardness, and geometric and positional tolerances
Preparation of a complete bill of materials
Secure application of freehand drawing fundamentals
Fundamentals of working with PTC Creo
Solving a given problem independently and creatively
Practical implementation of developed ideas and solutions
Use of various manufacturing processes (milling, turning, 3D printing)
Application of modern technologies (IoT, VR, AR)

assessment_methods.method: Exam tasks at the CAD workstation (MABB152)

assessment_rules: All examination performances (MABB151, MABB152, MABB153) are ungraded. For MABB151, knowledge is checked through written exercises and a test. For MABB152, participation in all lectures and lab sessions is mandatory; exercises performed during the events are certified as preliminary examination work. The exam for MABB152 consists of several tasks at the CAD workstation, given either at the end or unannounced during the semester. For MABB153, knowledge is checked by submitting a lab report and presenting the lab result.
